notes.title: Radiology Report
notes.author: Radiologist
notes.text:
Radiology Report
Date: 09/09/2026
Patient: Candelaria Greenholt, 70 y/o F

Exam: MRI spine

Findings: MRI 09/09/2026: T12 compression fx, marrow edema on STIR. No other acute fractures identified. No paraspinal soft tissue mass or abnormal enhancement. Spinal canal and neural foramina patent at all levels.

Impression: T12 compression fracture with marrow edema consistent with acute/subacute injury. No additional acute abnormalities detected.

notes.title: Spine Intervention Consultation
notes.author: Interventional radiologist
notes.text:
Spine Intervention Consultation
Date: 09/13/2026
Patient: Candelaria Greenholt, 70 y/o F

Hx: Compression fx noted on imaging. Referred for DEXA + osteoporosis program.

Exam: Tenderness localized to fracture site. No neuro deficits.

Labs: Fever to 38.9 C with elevated CRP; discitis at the fracture level is suspected.

Plan: Admit for IV abx, MRI spine to evaluate discitis extent. Consider biopsy if no improvement. Continue osteoporosis workup and management per DEXA results.

IR to be consulted for possible intervention if abscess or instability identified.
